name: Offer acceptance and withdrawal
description: Reject illegal transitions before and after acceptance.

name: Conditional, active, and fulfilled
description: Require all triggers and an outcome after activation.
testCode:
import main
r={'when':['a','b'],'do':'c','within':2}
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0]},8)=='CONDITIONAL'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3]},4)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3],'c':[2]},4)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[0],'b':[3],'c':[5]},5)=='FULFILLED'

name: Deadlines and late delivery
description: An outcome on the deadline is timely, but one day later is a violation.
testCode:
import main
r={'when':['a'],'do':'b','within':5}
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1]},6)=='ACTIVE'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1]},7)=='VIOLATED'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1],'b':[6]},8)=='FULFILLED'
assert main.commitment_state(r,{'a':[1],'b':[7]},8)=='VIOLATED'

name: Idempotent event processing
description: Count exact repeats once and reject conflicting IDs.

name: Six campaign scenarios
description: Check the ledger states and deduplicated payment.
testCode:
import main
s={n:main.run_case(n) for n in main.SCENARIOS}
status=lambda n,k:next(c['status'] for c in s[n]['ledger'] if c['id']==k)
assert all(status('SUCCESS',f'K{i}')=='FULFILLED' for i in range(1,6))
assert status('LATE_DELIVERY','K2')=='VIOLATED'
assert status('PAYOUT_MISSED','K5')=='VIOLATED'
assert all(status('WITHDRAWN_OFFER',f'K{i}')=='CONDITIONAL' for i in range(1,6))
assert status('COMPLIANCE_REJECTED','K4')=='CONDITIONAL'
assert status('COMPLIANCE_REJECTED','K5')=='CONDITIONAL'
assert s['DUPLICATE_PAYOUT']['event_count']==s['SUCCESS']['event_count']
